title: Magnet.fla: mask layer hierarchy not imported or shown in UI (Layer 5 → Ball/Walls/Magnets)
description:
fixtures/Magnet.fla has 'Layer 5' as a mask layer that parents Ball, Walls, Magnets, and another 'Layer 5' child layer. Two issues to fix end-to-end:

1. FLA IMPORT — Layer parent/child nesting not decoded:
In flash8-binary.ts, CPicLayer records contain a parentLayerIndex or similar field that establishes the mask→masked hierarchy. The current flash8-import.ts convertTimeline() may not be reading this correctly. Steps:
   a. Read the binary format: check flacomdoc (github.com/jindrapetrik/flacomdoc) CPicLayer fields for parentIndex or nesting depth
   b. Check flash8-binary.ts readCPicLayerRecord() for how layer type and parent/child relationships are decoded  
   c. In flash8-import.ts, ensure masked layers get parentLayerIndex set correctly so the layer model knows which mask layer owns them
   d. After the layer reversal (BOTTOM-TO-TOP → TOP-TO-BOTTOM), verify the parent indices are adjusted accordingly (if they're stored as indices, reversing the array changes the index mapping)

2. EDITOR UI — Layer hierarchy not shown in Timeline:
In packages/authoring-ui/src/Timeline.tsx, masked layers should be indented under their mask parent in the layer list. Check if Timeline.tsx renders layer parent/child nesting at all. If not, add indentation for layers whose parentLayerIndex is non-null, similar to how Flash 8 shows the nested hierarchy.

Start by opening fixtures/Magnet.fla with the FLA import and calling doc_summary or layer list to see what the current import produces. Then read the layer model type to understand the parentLayerIndex field.

Run the full test suite after any changes: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at 612 or higher)
